summary: Completed comprehensive testing of iteration 13 features: FX transparency, draft reminders (cart recovery), and family profile (saved travelers). All backend APIs working correctly (46/46 tests passed). Frontend components displaying correctly with proper authentication and data flow.

Backend: GET /api/admin/draft-reminders/pending returns items with id, email, traveler_count, reminder_count, due fields
Backend: POST /api/admin/draft-reminders/run with force=true sends reminders and respects max count limit (2)
Backend: GET /api/account/travelers requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: POST /api/account/travelers creates new traveler and prevents duplicates (upsert by passport_no)
Backend: POST /api/account/travelers with id updates existing traveler
Backend: DELETE /api/account/travelers/{id} removes traveler from list
Backend: Draft reminder count limit enforced (second sweep without force skips all)
Backend: All FX admin endpoints working (GET, PUT with margin_pct, manual_rate)
Backend: Visa types include price_usd and TRY prices calculated correctly with fx_rate
Backend: Pricing quote includes fx object with effective_rate
Backend: Document reminder automation working (pending list, send reminder, sweep)
Backend: Customer account login (code verification and lastname login)
Backend: Draft save/resume with resume_code validation
Backend: Visa guide content management (list, get, update, reset)
Frontend: FxNote badge displays on homepage with format '1 $ = X ₺ · kur bugün güncellendi'
Frontend: FxNote badge displays on /vize-tipleri page
Frontend: FxNote inline displays on visa guide pages (/dubai-vizesi/30-gun-tek-giris)
Frontend: Saved travelers panel correctly hidden when user NOT logged in on /basvuru
Frontend: Account login flow works (email + code verification)
Frontend: Account dashboard displays after successful login
Frontend: Saved travelers section visible on /hesabim page
Frontend: Empty state message shown when no saved travelers
Frontend: Logout functionality works correctly
Frontend: Email displayed correctly on account dashboard
